summary: Customer Portal Forms / Questionnaires iteration testing completed. All 18 backend API tests passed (1 skipped - no proofs for test customer). Key features verified: Portal forms navigation, GET /api/portal/forms with status filtering, GET /api/portal/forms/{request_id} returns request + questionnaire and marks as opened, POST /api/portal/forms/{request_id}/submit creates response and customer_form document, GET /api/admin-portal/forms returns sent requests with customer/job context, POST /api/admin-portal/forms/send creates form request (fixed ObjectId serialization bug), GET /api/portal/dashboard returns enriched stats including pending_forms/recent_documents/awaiting_approval, GET /api/portal/orders/{job_id} returns forms/messages/documents/invoice/customer_status_timeline sections, GET /api/portal/invoices/{invoice_id}/download returns PDF. Frontend UI verified: Portal Forms/Questionnaires nav tab with filter buttons and forms list, Form detail page with questions and submit button, Admin Portal Forms tab with Send Form dialog, Order detail page with Status Timeline (7 steps) and Forms/Messages/Documents/Invoice sections.

minor.issue: FIXED: MongoDB ObjectId not excluded from response causing 500 error - added request.pop('_id', None) before return

Portal Forms Navigation.description: Forms / Questionnaires nav item added to portal navigation, links to /customer-portal/forms

GET /api/portal/dashboard enriched stats.description: Returns pending_forms count in stats, recent_documents (unread docs), plus pending_forms/awaiting_approval/recent_documents arrays for widgets

GET /api/portal/forms.description: Lists form requests scoped to logged-in customer, supports ?status= filter parameter

GET /api/portal/forms/{request_id}.description: Returns request + questionnaire, marks form as opened (opened_at set, status to in_progress)

POST /api/portal/forms/{request_id}/subm.description: Saves questionnaire response, updates request status to completed, creates customer_form document linked to customer/job

GET /api/admin-portal/forms.description: Returns sent form requests with customer and job context for monitoring

POST /api/admin-portal/forms/send.description: Admin can send questionnaire to customer via portal (after ObjectId fix)

GET /api/portal/orders/{job_id} enriched.description: Returns customer_status_timeline (7 steps), forms, conversations, documents sections when data exists

GET /api/portal/invoices/{invoice_id}/do.description: Returns application/pdf with content-disposition attachment header

Portal Dashboard widgets.description: Shows Pending Forms stat card, pending forms widget with links, Action Required section with pending forms count

Portal Forms List Page.description: Shows forms list with filter buttons (all/pending/in_progress/completed/overdue), status badges, Open Form/View Submission buttons

Portal Form Detail Page.description: Displays questionnaire name/description, form fields with proper input types, submit button, submitted banner for completed forms

Admin Portal Forms Tab.description: Forms tab with badge count, list of sent forms with customer/status, Send Form dialog with customer/job/questionnaire/due date/instructions fields

Portal Order Detail Enriched Sections.description: Shows Status Timeline (Quote Approved→Completed→Invoice), Forms/Questionnaires, Messages, Documents, Invoice sections with Download PDF button
